“If you think about where we are today from an incentive standpoint, what does Trump have to gain by doing a deal on a war he started that resulted in a humiliating defeat?

From April to today, he had ample time to make a deal that would’ve been less humiliating than the blue tsunami on Nov. 3, and yet he didn’t.

We thought he did it in June, but it turned out it was just a market pump job for the SpaceX IPO. Yes, I am serious, because all you have to do is look at when the MOU was signed and when the IPO took place.

Hint: 2 days apart.

And newsflash: that MOU didn’t even last a week. Iran closed SOH shortly after the signing because Israel wouldn’t leave Lebanon, another non-starter issue.

But somehow, after the humiliating defeat, and after Iran has demonstrated the ability to influence an election in the most powerful country in the world, Trump will somehow come to his senses and realize that this war is all or nothing and concede on every point Iran is demanding?

Are you high?

It cannot be that obvious to me. It just cannot. I know I’m not that smart, so it makes this point even more baffling to me. Again, I can easily argue that he won’t do anything (militarily speaking), but saying they will come to a deal is just really crazy.”
